target_customer: Small and mid-size online retailers who wanted a store on their Facebook page
problem: Merchants had to rebuild their catalog by hand to sell on Facebook. Beetailer imported an existing web store into a Facebook tab with promotion tools and analytics.

founders.name: Laura Valverde
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch 2011 calls the three founders Spanish engineers; no further background.

founders.name: Juan Gallego
founders.background_notes: Listed on YC page and TechCrunch.

founders.name: Miguel Martinez Trivino
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch spells him Miguel A. Martinez.

competitors.name: Payvment
competitors.what: Helped retailers set up storefronts on Facebook
competitors.traction_then: Named by TechCrunch as the competing service; later reported about 200,000 merchants in 2013

technical_complexity.rationale: Importing product catalogs into a Facebook page tab through the platform's APIs is standard integration work.

defensibility.rationale: Relied on Facebook platform tabs and had direct rivals such as Payvment; features were copyable quickly.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Facebook commerce faded: in 2012 and 2013 retailers closed Facebook stores and Payvment shut down and moved merchants to Ecwid by March 2013. Beetailer's own end is not documented.

market_need_then: TechCrunch in March 2011 reported 900 retailers and over 434,000 products on Beetailer, suggesting early merchant interest in selling inside Facebook.

branding.community_and_virality: Covered by TechCrunch and Adweek in 2011; no merch or community found

brand_strength.rationale: Press coverage at launch but no brand assets or community found.

outcome_analysis: Beetailer's cause of shutdown is not public. It rode the 2011 Facebook commerce wave with 900 stores by March 2011, but Facebook storefronts largely failed over 2012 and 2013, a sign the platform dependency was the main risk. The factors listed are inferences from that market shift rather than a stated cause.
notes: The 20000 dollar Y Combinator seed on 2011-01-27 rests on CB Insights alone (read via search summary). Two funding searches found no other round. CB Insights labels it Seed Dead. founded_year unknown. beetailer.com returned HTTP 503. Failure factors are inferences.
